anna_ml: Ok proposing a compact 'smoke-signal' checklist for new model bring-up / quant experiments. Aim is a <30m quick sanity run before longer evals. Core checks (in order):
- ingest/sample sanity (response length/latency)
- safety/hallucination quick prompts
- perplexity / ppl baseline vs ref
- embedding alignment spot-check
- quant fidelity (8-bit vs fp16) parity

kevin_prod: love it. Can we make thresholds explicit? e.g., ppl_ratio<=1.1, rouge-L drop <=2%, hallucination_rate<=3%

maya_research: +1. Also add prompt-set seeds: 'core_smoke_50' + 10 adversarial QA items.

samir_infra: I'll wire a fast job in ci: `run_eval --suite core_smoke --model {candidate} --quant 8` — should finish <20m on p4d.

anna_ml: Pass criteria proposal:
- avg_ppl(candidate)/avg_ppl(ref) <= 1.08
- median_latency <= 250ms (hosted) or <= 20ms/token (dedicated)
- safety false-positive <= 5% and hallucination <=3%
- embeddings cosine_drop <= 0.02

maya_research: For quant checks, also require automatic KV-cache correctness: run `kv-check --seed 42 --steps 128`.

kevin_prod: I'll run one now on `redwood-open-v2` + q8. Posting logs shortly.
